name: 2025 NEW S1000 Pro Series 10 Smart Watch – 7-in-1 Multi-Strap Combo Set
description:
The S1000 Pro Series 10 Smart Watch is a feature-packed wearable designed for both men and women. With 7 interchangeable straps, it lets you match your watch to any occasion—fitness, work, or casual outings. Offering Bluetooth calling, fitness monitoring, and a sleek modern design, this smartwatch is built for style, health, and connectivity.

Key Features:

7-in-1 Strap Edition: Includes 7 stylish straps for daily customization

Wireless Magnetic Charging: Fast and convenient power-up

Full Touch Display: Large, clear screen with smooth navigation

Bluetooth Calling: Make and receive calls directly from your watch

Smart Notifications: Stay updated with calls, messages, and app alerts

Fitness & Health Tracking: Heart rate, sleep monitoring, step count, calorie tracking, and more

Sports Modes: Multiple activity modes to support your workouts

Water-Resistant Build: Suitable for everyday use

Compatibility: Works with both Android and iPhone devices

Package Includes:

1 × S1000 Pro Series 10 Smart Watch

7 × Interchangeable Straps

1 × Wireless Magnetic Charger

1 × User Manual

1 × Retail Box
